'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Jake Nelson LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jake Nelson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Informal sheet. Inventory Luke N.; sheet writes Jake Nelson / Super rouper. Podrace package.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jake Nelson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / There Is No Conflict|There Is Good In Him]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
